name: msg91-web-sdk-bootstrap-fix
changes: MSG91 Web SDK initialization now mirrors the documented provider onload bootstrap
OTP readiness no longer incorrectly requires retryOtp before the first OTP request
Resend gracefully falls back to a fresh send when an SDK build exposes retryOtp late
Provider load and method initialization timeouts now report clearer errors
MSG91 diagnostics are available through WMMsg91Otp.diagnostics()
New customer/listener registration and forgot-password continue to use MSG91 OTP; returning accounts use passwords
